gap_title: Expert 间无共享缓存 — 同一数据被重复拉取
source_title: Cheetah.ai: Shared context bridge - workflow DAG pre-warms KV cache
summary: Control plane reads workflow DAG, pre-warms next agent KV cache before current agent finishes. Restructures prompts to [SYS]+[DOC]+[TASK] for prefix cache hits. Subsequent agents TTFT < 0.5s.
implementation_hint: 在 lead.py 中引入 SharedDataCache 类，expert 拉取数据前先查 cache。cache key = f"{data_type}_{stock_code}"，TTL 按数据类型配置。
